svg.title: AI-Powered SOC Assistant — system architecture
svg.desc: Six-stage pipeline: NSL-KDD ingestion, feature engineering, parallel Random Forest and Isolation Forest detection with score fusion, a normal-traffic early exit and the MITRE ATT&CK family mapping, SHAP explainability, a LangGraph ReAct agent running locally with optional external LLM and threat-intel calls across a host boundary, and a six-section incident ticket. Headline metrics report the KDDTest+ novel-variant split.

svg.text: Explainable intrusion triage — one NSL-KDD connection record in, an analyst-ready incident ticket out.
